name: io.github.granturismo/devicespecs
description: Look up, search and compare normalized smartphone specifications (10,000+ phones) via the Device Specs API.

environment_variables.name: DEVICESPECS_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: RapidAPI key for the Device Specs API. Free tier at https://rapidapi.com/controller2042000/api/deviceultraparser

environment_variables.name: DEVICESPECS_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Override the API gateway base URL (default https://deviceultraparser.p.rapidapi.com/).
